personality_one_liner: An accessible, calm, high-contrast communication assistant translating sign language gestures into spoken voice and live readable text.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS spacing rhythm with clear grouping, padded containers, and comfortable touch targets ≥ 44pt.

do's: Use subtle blur on sticky bottom translation bar and header
Apply translucent tinted base for foreground text readability
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields
Avoid low contrast text over blurred hardware status

screens.name: LiveTranslate
screens.purpose: Primary live communication hub showing real-time translated tokens, sentence assembly, speech playback, and input source toggle.

states.empty: Awaiting gesture signals. Raise hand or perform sign...
states.error: Bluetooth connection lost. Tap to reconnect or switch to Camera Fallback.

screens.layout: Sticky top status pill for hardware/camera mode, giant high-contrast sentence display container, real-time word token ticker, sticky bottom action bar with Speak Aloud, Clear, and Input Mode switch.

screens.name: HardwarePair
screens.purpose: Manage Bluetooth glove/sensor hardware connection with clear scanning, connected, and troubleshooting states.

states.empty: No Bluetooth hardware detected. Make sure device is powered on.
states.error: Pairing failed. Please check device battery and try again.

screens.layout: Header with search refresh, list of discovered peripheral cards with signal strength indicator, manual connect button, and troubleshooting tips.

screens.name: CameraFallback
screens.purpose: Provides backup computer-vision hand sign recognition using front or back camera with manual switching.

states.empty: Position hand clearly within the camera frame.
states.error: Camera permission denied. Enable access in settings.

screens.layout: Full viewport camera preview with grid overlay, front/back switch button at top right, live recognized sign tag floating on screen.

screens.name: GestureDictionary
screens.purpose: Browse fixed signs, alphabet signs, scuba diving, bike riding, and customized gestures.

states.empty: No signs found matching your search.
states.error: Failed to load gesture library. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Search bar at top, category pill filter row (All, Alphabet, Scuba, Bike, Custom), vertical list of gesture cards with visual icon representation and translation text.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure text-to-speech voice speed, auto-speak toggle, haptic feedback, and custom gesture definitions.
screens.layout: Grouped iOS-style settings list with toggles for auto-speak, voice rate slider, haptic feedback, and 'Add Custom Gesture' modal trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict adherence to iOS-Native Clean personality with warm botanical accents (#3B7A57) and high-contrast typography.
The LiveTranslate screen must feature a sticky bottom translation bar with instant TTS playback and sentence clearing.
Implement robust Bluetooth state machine and camera fallback switcher with real-time feedback.
Every interactive element must have hitSlop and clear accessibility labels.
Zero tolerance for emoji in system UI or banned color families (indigo/violet/navy/purple).
